title: Burgertown workflows
notices: These connections come from the provider Arazzo recipes. They are not Atlas blast radius.

workflows.description:
Seeded tbl_4 / chk_ok. Read the due, tender card, capture, invoice.
Table frees; optional tip and rewards earn.

Fixture chk_paid / pay_paid / ch_paid. Accept a refund, reverse the
processor charge, then void. Void without a reversed refund is 409
void_not_allowed. API only — no restaurant screen.

Read the dinner board, open a dine-in check on an empty table, add a
Townie with selections[], send, bump the ticket. Last ticket done
marks the fulfillment ready. itm_86 on add is 409. Send with nothing
unsent is 409 nothing_to_send.

Apply LOCAL10 to chk_ok, re-read due_cents, pay the new due.
Paying the pre-discount 1736 after the code is 422 amount_mismatch.

Nine hops with three branch points — zone check, courier availability,
ready-gate on pickup. Creates a new delivery fulfillment; does not
reuse dlv_pending.

Same write endpoint as C. Each step below expects a distinct 4xx from
addItem, then the last step is the valid Townie. Five options in
modg_add is in HANDOFF but the live group only has three options, so
that row is not a step.

The stale-due trap. Redeem off_free_fries on chk_ok, re-fetch the
check, pay the new due. Skipping the re-fetch and paying 1736 is
422 amount_mismatch. Passing a stale check_version is 409
check_version_stale.

Fixture dlv_enroute. Fail the job; fulfillment stays ready.
The seeded check chk_enroute is unpaid, so the live path is cancel
fulfillment — inventory is not restocked. HANDOFF also describes a
paid recovery (refund → processor refund → void). That branch needs
a paid enroute fixture the seed does not have, so it is not a step.

Read-only filter plus one add that warns. Maya avoids alg_dairy and
is not strict, so a shake still 201s with warnings[]. 409
allergen_conflict only fires when dietary_profile.strict is true.
No guest on the seed is strict, so that 409 is not a step.
